rules: Scope source: the 11-step script in README.md. Seed ids live only in api/internal/seed/world.go; reference tests and decision-catalog rows, never ids.
At most one feature is in_progress at a time.
A feature becomes passing only after its verification command succeeds; record the command output date and commit in evidence.

Manual steps are walked in the UI after make seed and an API restart. A feature with passing auto evidence and an unwalked manual step is recorded as passing (auto) with 'UI walk pending' in evidence.
